item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description:
Bug fixes and polish.
• Voice isolation / mic indicator now clears immediately when a recording session ends — previously the engine stayed warm for the entire app lifetime. • Fresh AVAudioEngine per session; simpler lifecycle, no lingering hardware allocation. • Fixed cancel-while-starting race that could leave an orphan engine running if the hotkey was released during engine setup. • Start sound no longer gets cut off by voice-processing setup — it now plays after the engine is ready. • ASR model download progress bar is smooth instead of only showing 1% → 49% → 50% → done. • LLM result card height reduced ~20% — more compact without being cramped. • Removed the "Apple Silicon" tag from the speech model list (it was redundant).

item.title: Version 0.1.6
item.description: Add onboarding flow and extract UI theme components (TolkBadge, tolkCaption, tolkSecondary, tolkPrimary)

item.title: Version 0.1.7
item.description: Bug fixes and UI improvements

item.title: Version 0.1.8
item.description: Single unified hotkey — routes to Quick Action when text is selected, Dictation otherwise. Removes separate Ask hotkey. Design system polish: frosted glass overlays, consistent button styles, shared animation tokens.

item.title: Version 0.1.9
item.description: Settings redesign: Dictation and Quick Actions are now separate pages in the sidebar, making it easier to find and configure each feature independently. The Quick Action voice instruction prompt is now user-editable. Plain text mode removed.

item.title: Version 0.1.10
item.description:
Patch: text selection, overlay sizing, test fixes.
• Text selection now works reliably on all machines — Cmd+C fallback uses clipboard polling (up to 300ms) instead of a fixed 100ms wait that was too short for Chrome on slower systems. • Fixed QuickAction card sizing corruption when retriggering the hotkey — chip row overflow during the result→recording resize animation. • Fixed 12 broken tests from prior refactors; integration test suite now compiles (test count 237→241).

item.title: Version 0.1.11
item.description:
Fix: text selection now works in Chrome web content, Slack, Claude desktop, and other Chromium/Electron apps.
• Activates the accessibility tree (AXEnhancedUserInterface / AXManualAccessibility) for Chrome and Electron apps before querying selected text. Previously only worked on machines where something else had already activated Chrome's AX tree.

item.title: Version 0.1.12
item.description:
Text selection: delegate to SelectedTextKit's full strategy chain for broader app compatibility.
• Replaced custom Cmd+C fallback with SelectedTextKit's shortcut strategy (5ms polling, 400ms timeout, muted alert, robust clipboard handling). • Kept fast AX query + Chrome/Electron AX activation as first steps. • Should improve detection on apps where our custom Cmd+C was failing.

item.title: Version 0.1.13
item.description:
Fix: text selection now works universally — Chrome, Slack, Claude desktop, Numbers, and all other apps.
• Root cause: the unified hotkey used a fast AX-only check that skipped the full fallback chain (AX tree activation, Edit→Copy menu action, Cmd+C simulation). Apps without native AX text support always fell through to dictation. • Now: fast AX peek first, then full fallback chain before deciding. ~500ms delay in the "no selection" case for non-native-AX apps; instant for native apps. • Added detailed diagnostic logging ([SEL] [DIAG]) for future debugging.

item.title: Version 0.1.14
item.description:
Codebase cleanup: remove dead code and stale artifacts from prior refactors.
• Deleted 4 orphaned files (RecordingMode, EmbeddingService, unimplemented Firebase plan) • Removed 5 dead AppSettings fields, 4 dead properties/methods • Simplified text insertion to always use clipboard paste • Updated CLAUDE.md architecture docs to match current state

item.title: Version 0.1.15
item.description: Quick Action result buttons now match chip style. Faster hotkey routing: instant AX peek for native apps, AX tree activation for Chrome/Electron (≤200ms), skips slow Cmd+C path entirely.

item.title: Version 0.1.16
item.description:
Fix: text selection in Slack and Terminal now routes to Quick Action correctly.
• Adds menuAction (Edit→Copy via AX menu) to the fast routing path. Apps that don't expose AX selection but have a working Edit menu (Slack, Terminal, Discord, etc.) are now detected. • Dictation overlay still appears within ~250ms when no text is selected — fast-rejects via menu-disabled check.

item.description: Add Logs viewer in Settings for easy bug reporting, fix hotkey labels for non-US keyboards

item.title: Version 0.1.27
item.description:
**Reliability + hardening release.**
- Live model-load progress on first run; no more frozen overlay - Empty LLM result shows a proper error card with Retry instead of blank Copy/Replace - Hotkey recorder rejects system-reserved combos (⌘Q, ⌘Space, ⌘Tab, ⌘⇧3/4/5, ⌘⌥Esc, …) with inline feedback - Default prompt profile protected from deletion; provider selection auto-resets when the active provider is deleted - Keychain API-keys file: chmod before atomic rename closes a brief world-readable window - ASR model switches mid-load cancel the prior prepare cleanly; downloads have a 30-minute hard deadline - Hotkey re-registration during an active session now serialises against cancel - VAD buffer bounded so a stalled drain can't runaway-allocate - Many smaller robustness, UX, and consistency fixes - Build is now warning-free; all 280 tests pass

item.title: Version 0.1.28
item.description:
**UI consistency fix.**
- Logs tab now uses the same Form + grouped-sections layout as General, AI, and Quick Actions — no more jarring layout jump on tab switch - AI settings page title fixed (was stale "Dictation" after the sidebar rename in v0.1.27)

item.title: Version 0.1.29
item.description: Vocabulary for AI post-processing: add terms (with optional hints) that the LLM applies contextually during cleanup. Faster Logs panel for large session logs.

item.title: Version 0.1.30
item.description:
**Vocabulary polish + system prompt fine-tuning.**
Vocabulary - Per-entry on/off toggle removed — delete is the cleaner verb for entries you don't want - "AI off" banner now reacts live to the master toggle right above it - Soft cap (50 entries) is visible: Add Term disables at the cap with an inline note - Long hints are truncated at 200 chars in the rendered prompt; the editor shows a live counter - Save/delete only fires its UI-update notification when the disk write actually succeeded — no more ghost rows
System prompts - Cleaner, halved dictation prompt with the same anchors: transcript-as-content, fillers-out, voice preserved, URLs and dictated punctuation intact - All five Quick Action chips share the same scaffold (task → one example → identical output-contract footer) so the model sees a consistent format - New "Restore Defaults" button in the prompt list to adopt the new built-in text without losing your other profiles
Eval harness - New cross-provider prompt eval suite covers every built-in prompt against Apple Intelligence and (when a key is configured) Gemini - Property-based assertions catch real prompt regressions while tolerating LLM jitter
268 prior tests + 10 new cross-provider evals all passing.

item.title: Version 0.1.31
item.description:
**Cleaner reveal + auto-Enter cue.**
- Dictation overlay now does a deliberate double-pulse on appear (two slow glows separated by a 1-second gap), much easier to spot in peripheral vision than the previous quick fade - Long-press auto-Enter feedback redesigned: replaced the "progress ring" (which read as loading-cut-off when released early) with a green halo that appears only when you cross the threshold. Below threshold: nothing visible — the recording breath does the "still listening" job - The green halo persists through processing so the success cue carries through the entire flow - Smoother halo arrival (300 ms ease-out vs the previous 80 ms snap), no scale effect (sides + top/bottom of the pill now arrive together) - "Loading" / "Loading 42%" instead of "Loading speech model…" on first-run model download - Reduce Motion respected: halo and breath skipped, threshold progress kept (it's information, not motion) - Internal cleanups: clock unification, bounded TimelineViews, cached threshold without lock, several smaller reliability tweaks
279 tests passing.

item.title: Version 0.1.32
item.description: Halo polish — the green auto-Enter confirmation no longer gets shaved at the top and bottom edges of the overlay.

item.title: Version 0.1.33
item.description: Faster paste — the overlay now dismisses immediately after dictation lands instead of waiting on background clipboard cleanup. VS Code & other Electron editors no longer trigger the Quick Action overlay when you fire the hotkey with nothing selected.

item.title: Version 0.1.34
item.description: Reliability fixes — settings writes (API providers, prompt profiles, app bindings) now surface failures instead of silently dropping; duplicate Default profiles no longer accumulate after a transient SwiftData error; Quick Action no longer paste-replaces into the wrong app if activation refused; auto-Enter window halved to reduce wrong-target risk; concurrent paste calls serialized; final log lines survive hard exits.

item.title: Version 0.1.35
item.description: Internal cleanup release — no user-visible feature changes. Removes dead media-playback service, prunes 9 unused error cases, drops the placebo "Include beta releases" toggle (Sparkle was never wired through it), tightens save+notify behavior so settings UI accurately reflects writes, and consolidates a handful of duplicate constants and helpers.

item.title: Version 0.1.36
item.description:
Fix: media playback volume now restored reliably after dictation ends.
When dictation runs, macOS automatically reduces other apps' audio (Spotify, YouTube, Music, etc.) via voice-processing ducking. The volume should snap back to normal when dictation completes, but sometimes stayed reduced until you ran dictation again. Now explicitly disables voice processing before stopping the audio engine, so the session state cleans up correctly every time.

item.title: Version 0.1.37
item.description: macOS 15 (Sequoia) support — tolk now runs on every Mac that can run Sequoia. Apple Intelligence stays available on macOS 26.

item.title: Version 0.1.38
item.description: Now usable without AI configured — dictation still works, Quick Actions gracefully disabled with clear settings indicators.

item.title: Version 0.1.39
item.description: macOS 15 (Sequoia) launch fix — v0.1.37 and v0.1.38 silently failed to launch on Sequoia. This release works.

item.title: Version 0.1.40
item.description: Reliability improvements, design tweaks.

item.title: Version 0.1.41

item.title: Version 0.1.42
item.description: Onboarding, overlay, and provider modal polish.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description: Smoother first-run setup, more reliable model downloads and AI provider configuration, more robust settings storage, refreshed UI consistency, and many stability fixes. Note: this release rotates the update-signing key — if the in-app update fails, please download this version manually from the releases page; auto-updates resume afterward.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description: Fixes the crash that prevented tolk from launching on macOS 15 (Sequoia). If you're on macOS 15 and an earlier version never opened, download this version manually — auto-update can't run if the app never launched. No changes for macOS 26 users beyond minor internal cleanups.

item.title: Version 0.2.2
item.description: Reliability improvements: protects your clipboard when you copy during a dictation paste, surfaces an error when the microphone disconnects mid-recording instead of silently cutting off the transcript, more accurate model download progress, and consistent AI provider availability across onboarding and settings.

item.title: Version 0.2.3
item.description: Performance & reliability: - Faster hotkey response and lower dictation cold-start (ASR prewarm during routing, panel reuse) - Smoother Settings (recorder hotkey suppression, cached app resolver, bounded polling) - Log rotation moved off the write path to avoid hitches

item.title: Version 0.2.4
item.description: Smarter dictation prompts: multilingual dictation stays in your language (no more accidental translation), and the Continue quick action now keeps your original text instead of replacing it with only the continuation. Vocabulary terms also improve Apple Speech recognition directly — even with AI post-processing off — and the vocabulary settings now show when the term limit is reached.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description: Redesigned Settings, new speech engines, updated AI options, and more reliable dictation. Improved macOS app selection and corrected automatic updates. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
Tolk 0.4.0 adds meeting workflows and subscription CLI connections.
- Use installed Claude Code and Codex CLIs alongside existing API-key and on-device AI connections. - Record meetings with microphone and optional system audio, with pause, recovery, and resumable local transcription. - Prepare cited notes and editable work briefs. Export portable Markdown and JSON for people and agent tools. - Use the refined settings layout, three speech engines, and clearer recording controls. - Improve capture ownership, shared model inference, saved-data recovery, and shutdown reliability.
Available speech engines: Parakeet Ultra, Parakeet Redux, and Apple Speech. CLI connections require the installed command and its existing subscription login.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. These builds use Tolk Dev signing and are not notarized by Apple.

item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description: Improve Claude Code and Codex CLI discovery and account access checks. Add executable selection, custom login folders, clear access recovery, and safe setup details. Preserve settings drafts and prevent stale readiness results.

item.title: Version 0.4.2
item.description:
Prepare work from selected text, notes, and meeting follow-ups. Keep source evidence, annotations, todos, and reviewed briefs together in the new Home and Inbox workspace.
Copy or export portable work packets. Optionally launch selected workflows through Herdr Core. The Herdr app and TUI remain optional. Workflow programs and skills stay independent from Tolk.
This release also improves revision checks, capture cancellation, unsaved-draft recovery, and quit handling. Typed workspace use supports Set Up Later without microphone, model, or AI setup.
Apple Silicon. macOS 15 or later. The application is signed and is not notarized.

item.title: Version 0.4.3
item.description:
Prepare work in fewer steps. Prepare Work saves input and opens one Review & Start screen, with the workflow and folder above the proposal. Tolk remembers the last valid confirmed destination.
Herdr sessions now attach to a local Herdr space when its app is installed. Reveal in Herdr attaches an existing session without launching another one. Select its tab in Herdr. Herdr remains optional. Copy, Export, and Core-only workflows remain available.
This refinement also improves save-error visibility, cancellation, quit handling, compact layouts, and review recovery after interrupted saves.
Apple Silicon. macOS 15 or later. Signed application; not notarized.

item.title: Version 0.4.4
item.description:
Tolk 0.4.4 refines the productivity workspace and external handoffs.
- Use a wider workspace with source context beside notes and reviews. - Review and edit prepared work in the main area. Keep drafts across navigation and window closure. - Continue in Codex or Claude desktop apps after explicit review. Tolk never submits the task automatically. - Use Haiku and Luna defaults for Claude Code and Codex CLI enrichment. Explicit model choices remain available. - Open Herdr from linked work with bounded startup handling and clear tab-selection guidance. - Keep dictation available after closing the workspace window.
This Apple Silicon release requires macOS 15 or later. It uses Tolk Dev signing and is not notarized.

item.title: Version 0.4.5
item.description:
Tolk 0.4.5 gives captured text a useful place beside dictation and Quick Actions.
- Save selected text as a note or todo directly. - Keep original source context, add intent, and track optional subtasks. - Edit in one native document. Changes save automatically. - Browse captures in one sidebar, with contextual window actions. - Use system colors and native controls, including Liquid Glass on macOS 26. - Delegate when useful. AI preparation and structured review remain optional. - Reuse the last successful app or workflow and working folder. - Preserve edits through concurrent saves, navigation, window closure, and Quit.
This Apple Silicon release requires macOS 15 or later. It uses Tolk Dev signing and is not notarized.

item.title: Version 0.4.6
item.description:
- Save the text shown in Quick Action as a note or todo. Tolk keeps the original selection as source context. - A green outline confirms the save, then the Quick Action card closes. - Find saved work under Captures, with search and filtering together. Configure workflow profiles in Settings. - Click disclosure titles to expand sections. Editor sheets are larger and fit the current window. - Notes and todos keep their editing state during automatic saves and resizing. Undo is available for deleted captures and subtasks. - Codex and Claude handoffs start with the selected task or reviewed goal.
For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. This release uses Tolk Dev signing and is not notarized.

item.title: Version 0.4.7
item.description:
- Release capture reservations when startup stops early or a Quick Action declines the handoff. - Bound long AI streams and keep valid text when Anthropic sends invalid usage counts. - Keep a recovery copy when Tolk cannot restore a settings backup. History cleanup skips unnecessary writes and retains rows if saving fails. - Save edited notes and todos faster, especially when they contain many source passages. - Preserve saved Herdr paths while Workflows loads. Apply the automatic update preference with one settings write. - Use consistent AI endpoint validation and send the saved Anthropic thinking mode. - Keep complete lines in diagnostic previews. Read meeting checkpoints through the shared private file reader. - Fit Settings forms to the available window space.
For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. This release uses Tolk Dev signing and is not notarized.

item.title: Version 0.4.8
item.description:
- Give split menus more room around the chevron. The wider area opens the menu in New, Open With, and Add Annotation. - Use consistent button padding and icon targets in the workspace, Settings, History, and setup screens. - Align note and todo titles with workspace headers. Give Settings titles more space below the tabs. - Put Retry Save in the original Quick Action button slot and give the error message the full card width.
For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. This release uses Tolk Dev signing and is not notarized.

item.title: Version 0.4.9
item.description:
- Choose Iterate or press the shortcut again to revise the current Quick Action draft, including manual edits. - Retry replays a failed request. Failed or canceled iterations keep the last completed draft. - Make both selection overlay sizes 20% wider and taller. Use text-only buttons for Iterate, Save Note, and Add Todo. - Fix a layout crash when switching notes and todos. Keep the current editor visible while a capture opens. - Record structured dictation timings and failure codes. Keep test logs separate from real sessions.
For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. This release uses Tolk Dev signing and is not notarized.

item.title: Version 0.4.10
item.description:
- Retake records a fresh Quick Action instruction against the original selection. Iterate uses the displayed draft. - Retake keeps the previous draft visible during recording and preserves it if the request fails. Retry repeats the failed request. - The selection overlay gives the waveform and action chips more vertical space. Result text has a slightly tighter inset, and Save Note and Add Todo sit farther from the bottom. - Model loading clears its progress when canceled. Retired project files and unused code were removed, and the agent documentation now maps the current architecture.
For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. This release uses Tolk Dev signing and is not notarized.

item.title: Version 0.4.11
item.description: - Record and Prepare now creates a transcript and prepared work after you stop. Transcript Only keeps processing on your Mac. - Refine starts recording from a note, todo, or reviewed meeting brief. Iterate adds spoken follow-ups to the current draft. - Save a refined note as a todo with subtasks. Existing todos keep their subtasks and completion states.

item.title: Version 0.4.12
item.description: - Removed the lines between Quick Action rows. The panel now resizes correctly after a rapid reopen. - Reduced audio conversion overhead. A newer clipboard copy releases the next paste from the previous restore delay. - Protected meeting checkpoints across store instances. Partial transcripts resume with the speech model that produced their saved passages. - Todo retries reopen saved edits. Open Quick Action cards honor the AI toggle, and custom provider URLs retain escaped paths.

item.title: Version 0.4.13
item.description:
Security and privacy hardening for Tolk.
- Remote AI connections require HTTPS. Local HTTP connections remain supported. - AI requests stay on the configured origin. Provider error bodies stay out of diagnostics. - Tolk checks access to saved API credentials and installed AI command-line executables more strictly. - Tolk verifies the update feed and checks update archive signatures before extraction. - Removed the unused Apple Events permission. - Public speech model downloads ignore inherited Hugging Face tokens and registry overrides.

item.title: Version 0.4.14
item.description:
- Type an instruction or follow-up in Quick Actions. The overlay stays compact while listening or processing and expands for the result. - Recover more selected text in Slack and other web-based apps. Replace checks that the original selection is still safe to edit. - Export a note or todo as Markdown, add a subtask with Shift+Return, and save a capture with its title cleared. - Open a capture in another app or start a workflow from the same menu. See live status for linked Herdr sessions while the capture is open. - Give compatible local MCP clients read-only access to saved captures. Enable it from Settings or Setup Assistant. - Use narrower native scrollbars, more consistent toolbar spacing, and shared draft editors that keep your changes after a failed save.
For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. This build uses Tolk Dev signing.

item.title: Version 0.4.15
item.description:
- Create an optional email account from Settings. Dictation, notes, meetings, and Quick Actions still work signed out. - Manage corrections and writing preferences together in Personalization. - Read dictation History beside the transcript in wider windows. - Use more of the workspace width and see live workflow session activity on saved captures.
For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. This build uses Tolk Dev signing.

item.title: Version 0.4.16
item.description: Type now sits after Add Todo in the Quick Action overlay. A multiline editor supports Shift-Return for a new line and Return to apply. Typed and spoken requests share the compact Transforming card. Turn Type off in Settings → Quick Actions → Type instructions.

item.title: Version 0.4.17
item.description: - Quick Action Options brings typing and dictation together. The overlay shows clearer feedback for silence and recording errors. - Captures, work drafts, and meetings export directly to Markdown. - Linked Herdr sessions support live terminal preview and explicit messages to eligible agents. - AI processing settings group personalization and the default dictation prompt. Local MCP setup can copy one setup prompt and check the Codex connection.

item.title: Version 0.4.18
item.description: - Sign in with Google from Settings → Account. - Choose whether to sync notes, todos, and personalization across Macs. Meetings and credentials stay on the Mac. - Removed retired settings paths and updated Tolk’s workspace and capture guides.

item.title: Version 0.4.19
item.description: - Improved selected-text handling across native editors, browser apps, and terminals. Replace checks that the original selection is still active. - Added a direct Type action to Quick Action. The result preview hides outer blank lines and preserves the full text for Copy and Replace. - Simplified opening notes and todos in Codex and Claude, local MCP setup, and onboarding.

item.title: Version 0.4.20
item.description: - Consistent native buttons across the workspace, Settings, Setup Assistant, and Quick Actions. Icon actions share their sizing and help. - Quick Action Send matches the composer controls. Choose Iterate to type or speak a follow-up from the result. - Notes and todos can dock a live terminal for a linked local Herdr session. The pane supports scrollback, resize, and direct keyboard input.

item.title: Version 0.4.21
item.description: - Open a note or todo in Codex or Claude from its own toolbar button. Run Workflow has a separate chooser for the profile and working folder. - A confirmed local workflow opens its Herdr terminal in the workspace. Switch back to the note or todo and return without losing your place. Stopped sessions keep their output visible. - Add Annotation opens a text field. Previously transcribed annotations remain editable. - Edit Prompt sits next to the default dictation prompt. Workflow settings show profiles and the Herdr connection. - Optional usage analytics starts off. You can enable it in Settings → General → Privacy.

item.title: Version 0.4.22
item.description:
- Keep an editable note or todo above its Herdr terminal in a resizable split. Terminal input keeps its shortcuts while focused, and the sidebar shows session status. - Simplify Herdr connection settings and give split-button chevrons more space. - Reduce the data stored by Notes and Todos sync and tighten Analytics consent.
If you sync Notes or Todos, update all your Macs together. Older Tolk versions cannot read records converted by this release.
